title: Scottish Ambulance Service — Emergency & Pre-Hospital Care AI Deep-Dive Governance Pack
description: 12-entry-point AI governance framework for the Scottish Ambulance Service (SAS) — the national NHS ambulance service for Scotland — covering emergency operations centres, air ambulance, patient transport, community first responders, trauma, resuscitation, telehealth, fleet, workforce wellbeing, data analytics, and CBRN resilience. Red lines: no AI-sole clinical triage or dispatch; no patient-identifiable data outside UK jurisdiction.
